title: Persona-Jailbreak Resistance Benchmark
original_idea: Create 150 persona-jailbreak prompts at varying levels of sophistication. Evaluate three models and measure refusal rates, partial compliance rates, and the point in a conversation where compliance emerges.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Persona-jailbreaks are a high-volume real-world attack vector. Systematic benchmarking complements existing AILuminate jailbreak work.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Creating persona-jailbreak prompts at varying sophistication levels requires understanding of jailbreak techniques. Measuring partial compliance adds evaluation complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 150 prompts at varying sophistication plus multi-turn compliance tracking. Ambitious for 30 hours but could be narrowed.

novelty.reasoning: Research on persona-based jailbreaks is well-developed. Evolved persona prompts reduce refusal rates by 50-70% (arXiv:2507.22171, 2025). JailbreakBench provides a standardized evaluation framework including persona-based attacks. The MLCommons Jailbreak Benchmark v0.5 (Dec 2025) includes systematic jailbreak resistance evaluation across T2T and VLMs. Roleplay-based prompt injections achieve 89.6% ASR, the highest among attack categories. The proposed 150-prompt persona-specific benchmark overlaps significantly with these existing resources, though measuring partial compliance rates at conversation turn granularity has some incremental value.
